proofs.text: Write `greeting.py` and `tests/test_greeting.py`, run init twice and verify `.gitignore` carries the line `mutants/` exactly once

rule_text: Writing the mutmut block also appends `mutants/` to the project's `.gitignore`, once and never twice, so the copy mutmut breaks is never committed

tests.body:
def test_the_mutmut_copy_is_ignored_once(self, project):
        write(project.path('greeting.py'), 'def greet(name):\n    return name\n')
        write(project.path('tests/test_greeting.py'), 'def test_greet():\n    pass\n')
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        lines = read(project.path('.gitignore')).splitlines()
        assert lines.count('mutants/') == 1
